name: Unstable Overlook
disable: DC 20 Acrobatics check to tread lightly across the overlook onto more stable ground. Permanently disabling the hazard requires several hours of work and a successful DC 23 Crafting check check (trained).

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A Small or larger creature moves onto the weakened section of the overlook

---
Effect The ledge collapses. Any creature on the ledge that fails to grab-an-edge dc=20 plummets 40 feet into the chasm below.

text: A ledge overlooks a yawning chasm.
